name: furnished-lu
description: Live availability, all-inclusive prices and booking links for furnished rooms in shared flats, studios and apartments in Luxembourg, with listing details, rental terms and a contact request.

interface.longDescription:
Furnished.lu rents furnished rooms in shared flats (coliving), studios and apartments for medium and long stays in Luxembourg: about 790 homes in some 35 districts of Luxembourg City and other towns. This plugin lets ChatGPT answer housing questions with live data instead of guesses.

What it does:
- search_listings: finds the homes that are really available for a move-in date, filtered by budget, area and type, with the all-inclusive monthly price, size, area, a photo and a booking link pre-filled with the date. Without an area, it returns a mix of Luxembourg City districts and other towns.
- get_listing: details of one listing from its reference, a Furnished.lu link or an atHome.lu ad: size, bathroom, number of bedrooms in the flat, photos, description, free date and booking link.
- get_rental_terms: how renting works (all-inclusive price, move-in on the 1st or 15th, 250 EUR advance payment, free cancellation within 7 days, guarantee, studio fees, visits, contact).
- request_contact: with the user's explicit consent, sends their email or phone and a short summary to the Furnished.lu team, who contact them during opening hours.

Intended users: newcomers to Luxembourg, interns, students and young professionals looking for a furnished room or studio.

Limitations: availability is known 12 months ahead; leases start on the 1st or the 15th of a month; booking and payment are done by the user on furnished.lu, never in the chat; no tenant data is available through this plugin.
capabilities: Search available furnished rooms and studios in Luxembourg
Get the details and photos of one listing
Explain rental terms, deposit and fees
Send a contact request to the team, with consent
defaultPrompt: Find me a furnished room in Luxembourg for January, under 1,000 euros a month.
Which studios are available in Luxembourg City from March?
How does renting a room with Furnished.lu work?

positive.prompt: Find me a furnished room in Luxembourg for January 1st, under 1,000 euros a month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists available rooms with all-inclusive price, area, size, photo and a booking link pre-filled with the date; mixes Luxembourg City districts and other towns.

positive.description: Search in one area, date not on the 1st or 15th
positive.prompt: I need a room in Bonnevoie from December 3rd.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that leases start on the 1st or 15th, searches from December 15th and lists rooms in Bonnevoie only, cheapest first.

positive.description: Details of a listing by reference
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the room ALZ 92-22.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns type, area, size, bathroom, bedrooms in the flat, price, free date, photos, short description and booking link.

positive.prompt: How does the deposit work, and can I cancel?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the 1,000 EUR guarantee (SEPA mandate or card imprint, nothing debited), the 250 EUR advance payment deducted from the first rent and free cancellation within 7 days.

positive.description: Contact request with consent (reviewer address writes nothing)
positive.prompt: I want a studio for my company's interns. Please have someone contact me at review-test@furnished.lu, I agree to share it.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms consent, sends the request and says the team will contact the user during opening hours (Monday to Friday, 9:00-18:00). The reviewer address returns test=true and writes nothing.

negative.prompt: Find me a furnished room in Paris for next month.
Show me the contract and rent balance of the tenant in room CAN 214-03.
Book room LUX 193-12 now and charge my credit card.

publication.release_notes: First version: live availability search, listing details, rental terms and contact request.
